After we lost the first round, our Star-Lord typed we were the worst tanks so I hoped on Mantis and told them they could tank (they didn’t), and right before that I told our Peni she was playing into her counters (including Storm and Squirrel Girl). The entire of second round was me trying to heal our team, trying to push but failing because our new second tank, Venom, was either on point where we couldn’t see him, or trying to dive two tanks with a clear indication of a nest being right next to them. I also messed up and tried to get on point, but walked over the webs and died. The entire time Iron Man is saying to push…with 2 tanks either dead or out of line of sight, me and Invis TRYING to push, and our team constantly trying to surrender. 

Safe to say, we didn’t win that match. 😂
